curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42065-1-1.pdf (one book: motors steps 40-49, battery box and receiver 50-55, body tilting down onto the chassis step 97, remote step 100, driving page 69)

functions.does: The M motor at the back right drives the right track: its shaft's axle runs straight into the right rear sprocket.
functions.source: book: steps 40-42 and 48 (motor and sprocket on its shaft), page 69 (remote driving pictures); which motor drives which track is read from the model
functions.note: The motor (p133 58120) turns the control, the axle on its shaft. It is worked from the IR remote's right lever.

functions.does: The M motor at the front left drives the left track: its shaft's axle runs straight into the left front sprocket.
functions.source: book: steps 40-42 and 49 (the second motor), page 69; read from the model
functions.note: The motor (p290 58120) turns the control, the axle on its shaft. It is worked from the IR remote's left lever.

functions.does: With both tracks driven the same way the racer drives straight forwards or back; with one track driven it turns; with the tracks driven opposite ways it spins on the spot.
The idler sprockets and the eight white road wheels turn freely as the tracks run round them.
The whole green body tilts up on pins at its front, so the battery box can be reached, and folds back down over the chassis.
functions.source: book: step 97 (the red arrow lowers the body onto the chassis), page 68 (inset: body tilted up)

functions.does: The battery box's switch turns the power on and off.
